verdict.rationale: The pack documents agent checkout plumbing, including single-use delegated tokens bound to the merchant ID with amount and time limits. It also documents dispute and refund tools and standard fees. Nothing states fraud-liability allocation, chargeback responsibility, or seller-protection rules for agent-initiated transactions. Token restrictions and dispute-management functions are adjacent controls, not a documented statement of who bears the risk.

support.subject: As a merchant, the fraud, liability, and chargeback rules for agent-initiated transactions are documented so I know who bears the risk
